# googleads_customer (Data Source)

Read-only metadata about a Google Ads customer (account). Useful for guarding HCL with preconditions on test_account / manager.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "googleads_customer" "self" {
  customer_id = "1234567890"
}

output "currency" {
  value = data.googleads_customer.self.currency_code
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `customer_id` (String) Google Ads customer ID (digits only).

### Read-Only

- `currency_code` (String) ISO 4217 currency, e.g. USD.
- `descriptive_name` (String) Account display name.
- `manager` (Boolean) True if this is an MCC (manager) account.
- `resource_name` (String) customers/{id}
- `test_account` (Boolean) True if this is a sandbox/test account.
- `time_zone` (String) IANA time zone.
